---
title: "Rössler System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& -y-z\\
\dot{y} &=& x+ay\\
\dot{z} &=& 1+xz-bz
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.5, b=3$ and initial condition $(3,-2,1)$.
